title: BASF SE - Aerogel Solutions
content: BASF SE, the world's largest chemical company based in Ludwigshafen, Germany, offers advanced aerogel solutions as part of its performance materials portfolio. BASF's Slentite aerogel panels are polyurethane-based aerogel insulation boards that combine excellent thermal insulation with mechanical strength and easy processing. These panels are used in building insulation, refrigeration, and industrial applications. BASF leverages its extensive chemical expertise and global research infrastructure to continuously innovate in aerogel technology, focusing on sustainability and energy efficiency.
